faqs.question: Do you guarantee account recovery?
faqs.answer: No. Recovery depends on the nature of the issue, platform policies, available evidence, and many other factors. Every case is evaluated individually.

faqs.question: How long does recovery take?
faqs.answer: Recovery time depends entirely on the complexity of the issue. Some cases can be resolved quickly, while others may require additional investigation or platform review.

faqs.question: What information do you require?
faqs.answer: The required information depends on the specific issue. Only information necessary for diagnosis and recovery will be requested.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes. Remote services are available for clients worldwide.
